about: Ablation sets for the combined proof (scripts/proof.ts): each stage's mechanisms switched off with everything else on, run against an all-on baseline at the same settings. A stage owner declares its set; null means not declared yet, and the full proof refuses to start until every set is declared. Values are registry overrides (createWorld params).

C7a.note: The C6b values of the C7a knobs (artifacts/validation/c7a/pipeline.log); C7c's joint trips build on C7a's committed trips, so this ablation also weakens C7c. coreHungerRelief 0 switches off the C7a amendment made in C8 (an adult female's core-area cost × (1 − hunger); docs/staging/c8-lactation-diagnosis.md, logged as a C7a amendment in docs/staging/c8-targets.patch.json): it belongs to the stage it amends, so it is here and not in the C8 set.

C7c.note: Joint trips and waiting off; the energetic distance scale (62,900 m) back to the C7a fit (60,000 m). Depletable fallback foods are already off by default (fallbackCapH 0). Confirmed by the C7c owner: with this set the C7c merge (762a259) gives field worlds hash-identical to main before it (cacf3e7), seeds 48 and 3303 after 5 days.

C7e.note: C7d route chaining and the C7e goal-distance scale. The C7d direction check and the C7e fit (against Taï) dropped both, so both are 0 by default and this set equals the defaults. Checked: the C7d/C7e branch with this set is hash-identical to main 342baa9 (seeds 48 and 3303, 5 days). The C7b switches (followCommit, tripRateValue, cropFullExp) and the C7c fallback limits (fallbackCapH) are also 0 by default.

C8.note: Declared by the C8 owner: every C8 switch off (the guardian levers and bereavement: A2 of docs/staging/early-life-prereg.md; the prenatal channel; epidemics; snares; condition in fertility; growth in strength). The C7a amendment of the core cost (coreHungerRelief) is switched in the C7a set. Not exactly pre-C8: the condition -> health term, the self-feeding ramp (which replaced hazardOrphan), the adoption fixes, the fertility curve and the re-fitted baseline (minus an epidemic hazard of 0 when arrivals are 0) have no switch.

party-share.note: Party-size stage, crowding by the crown's share off: the habitat-index crowding cost and the sociability x fruit-index trip bonus of the model before (hash-identical with party-oestrus also off; docs/staging/party-size-prereg.md 4.1).

party-oestrus.note: Party-size stage, the pull of females in oestrus on males off (hash-identical to the model before with party-share also off; docs/staging/party-size-prereg.md 4.2).

C8c.note: The C8c lactation-cost taper off: the constant lactation hunger cost of C8 (hash-identical to the model before C8c; docs/staging/c8c-lactation-taper.md).

C10.note: All C10 switches; off reproduces the pre-C10 world exactly (tests/sim-signals.test.ts).

patrols.note: All C6 patrol corrections off: the C6 community danger grid instead of per-chimp contact memory (P2), the C6 cluster instead of single file and calls allowed (P4a), the energy gate back (A2), the heard-strangers boost (P1), staleness-only routes (A1), the 2.5 h cap (A3), the alpha lead bonus (A4), uniform pace and no release (P4a). Female participation settings (P3) keep their values, which are today's literals.

C13a.note: The rules decision policy (intention gate and sampling) off: the argmax rules (tests/sim-rg.test.ts).

C13b.note: Food valued by intake rate off: feeding and trip worth as before C13 (with rgOn 0 as well, hash-identical to the model before C13).

C13c.note: The C13c follow-up off: the 90-min intention age and the hunger-capped feeding time of C13 (hash-identical to C13).

C13d.note: C13d is off by default (a pre-registered null result, 30 September 2026); this row switches it ON, so the comparison with the all-on baseline measures it. The row's sign is reversed relative to the other stages.

C13e.note: C13e off: the joint trip only beyond the 5 m minimum and without its own slot, the C7a departure cue, and the near-automatic party-follow value (hash-identical to before C13e).
